text:
Priya: Quick sync request — proposing a 'fastpath' admission for small requests that bypasses full reservation if we have transient burst credits. Thinking this will cut p99 for interactive apps.
Alex: Love the idea. Can you sketch invariants? e.g., when is fastpath allowed vs full-reserve?
Priya: Basic rules: 1) request token size < small_threshold 2) tenant_token_balance + burst_credit >= fastpath_cost 3) current_pool_cpu_load < 80% 4) fallback to full-reserve or queue if anything fails.
Marta: How do we avoid starving low-volume tenants when big tenants hog burst credits? Need per-tenant burst caps + decay.
Jon: Agree. Also track effective_concurrency per-tenant. Fastpath should decrement a soft-burst counter that decays over 5-15m.
Priya: Exactly. Proposed counters: tenant_soft_burst, tenant_hard_limit, global_burst_pool. Soft_burst decays with half-life 10m.
Alex: What about correctness with operator restarts? Counters must be eventually consistent; can store in redis with TTL and jittered renewals.
Marta: And we must ensure cost accounting: mark fastpath usage differently so billing doesn't undercount token cost.
Priya: Billing note: tag requests with admit_mode=fastpath and emit metric billing.fastpath.tokens. Downstream can aggregate.
Jon: One tricky bit: warmup. If fastpath is used a lot for a tenant, it may hide the need to prewarm model weights. Should we surface a warmup_recommendation metric?
Priya: Yes — emit warmup_suggestion when fastpath_success_rate > 60% and sustained qps > prewarm_threshold.
Alex: Migration path: 1) feature-flag in control plane, 2) enable for 5% tenants, 3) hold metrics 2 weeks, 4) expand. Rollback if p99 regresses.
Marta: Rollout safety: add admission sampling — randomly force full-reserve for X% of fastpath admits to compare latency and cost.
Jon: Implementation sketch for admission check (pseudo):
```
if req.size < SMALL && tenant.soft_burst > 0 && global_pool.available > MIN:
  tenant.soft_burst -= cost
  emit(metric: fastpath_admit)
  return ADMIT_FASTPATH
else:
  call full_reserve_flow()
```
Priya: Ops concerns: operator liveness + race on soft_burst. Use CAS on redis keys, fallback to full_reserve on CAS failures.
Alex: Who owns the operator changes? I can take the operator-side CAS + metrics plumbing. Priya, can you own control-plane gating + rollout? Marta does billing tagging?
Priya: Yep, I'll own gating + rollout dashboard.
Marta: I'll wire billing tags and add queries for fastpath token reconciliation.
Jon: I'll prototype soft_burst decay logic in the simulator and run 48h traffic replay to check oscillations.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: checklist/fastpath-admit-6532104321. Items: canary-5pct, metrics-dash, billing-queries, redis-cas-tests.
Priya: Risks to call out in RFC: (a) unfair burst capture by noisy tenants, (b) hidden warmup causing tail latency spikes later, (c) billing mismatch if tagging misses.
Alex: Mitigations: caps + decay, warmup_suggestion + prewarm pipeline, end-to-end billing smoke tests.
Marta: One more: long tail GC of soft_burst keys could cause mem pressure; use TTL and periodic compaction job.
Priya: Ok next steps: Jon to simulate (ETA 3d), Alex to draft operator PR (ETA 1w), Marta to add billing queries (ETA 3d), I'll draft rollout playbook (ETA 2d).
Alex: Cool. Sync Friday 10am to review metrics from sim + initial dashboards. :thumbsup:
Priya: Thanks — will post follow-up RFC with the pseudo API changes and rollout playbook.
